title: 12-apps: group OSCORE-encrypted position beacons (18.2.4)
description: spec/12-apps.md 18.2.4 'Group Beacon Encryption': in group mode, position beacons are encrypted with the group OSCORE key and sent to ff35 group multicast. Not implemented anywhere — C beacons are public-mode only (tracked by bead l1qw.10.5.1.4); Python include_position_in_beacon() only for PUBLIC (position_privacy.py:109-111); group-mode reads authorize by a context string with no group crypto on the beacon path. Suggested placement: coap_location.c beacon path + position_privacy.py; needs group-OSCORE multicast first. See docs/spec-coverage/12-apps.md R-12-021.
